healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Outpatient physical and occupational therapy clinics, managed therapy facilities for hospitals and physician groups, and on-site employer services.

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Physical and occupational therapy, including orthopedic, sports, and neurological rehabilitation, plus industrial injury prevention.

patient_activity_volume.label: Patient activity / volume
patient_activity_volume.value: High annual volume of outpatient therapy visits.

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix
payer_revenue_mix.value: Commercial and managed care plans lead outpatient therapy revenue, with Medicare, workers’ compensation, and other payers.

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Fee-for-service outpatient therapy and contracted on-site industrial injury prevention services.

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Large nationwide network of outpatient therapy clinics, with additional therapy facilities managed for third parties.

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Outpatient preventive, preoperative, and postoperative care, with rehabilitation for orthopedic conditions, sports injuries, neurological injuries, and work-related injuries.

notes: Clinical operating quality metrics remain unverified.
